provenance.giver: lang/es — honorifics that precede a personal name in Spanish (don/doña, señor/señora/señorita, and their abbreviations); a declared closed class, added 2026-09-28 as E6 of the fast-reasoning experiment: a language is a file, never an organ edit
provenance.note: Particles (de, del, la, y) are the mul file's; this file adds only the titles. A Spanish double surname (García Márquez) reads as given + head under the Western-order head rule — a disclosed limit of the organ, not of this prior.
